goal: Implement an independent 7-9 hop source generator and qualify only nonreserved fixtures; never generate/inspect protected confirmation absent independent source-born first-use authority.

protected.build_guard: Always fail closed; no receipt/signature verifier connected; independently signed single-use custody and source adapter required.

environment.route_count: Exactly one 7-9-hop role+token-consistent positive route, zero negative, at least five role-only candidate routes per paired graph.
environment.topology: Three junctions at depths 2,4,6 with two competing branches each; near-collision, wrong-role alias, parallel multiedge, repeated-key and late-cross-route families.
environment.matched_pair: Swap one necessary src token with an off-role src token; preserve graph, degree, roles, start/end, and entire token multiset.
environment.anti_oracle: No label, source seed, correct path, precomputed raw equality, oracle bit or selected route in public observation.

first_use_requires: Authentic independent authorized witness with verified public key; never forge/self-issue signature.
Freeze protected source-activation adapter SHA and audit source-birth, no reserved inspection in unit tests.
Verify original trained F124-H Arm B weights, threshold 0.5, original source and C12/C14/C16 controls.
Review and qualify validation-only 7-9-hop model interface: original F124-H inference currently refuses non 4/5 depth.
Single-use append-only custody, crash-safe replay fencing, no retries/tuning, independent actual confirmation receipt.
Only then produce original 48 reserved seeds per lane with 2 pinned vectors, publish positives/negatives and resource evidence.
